The Critic - a second model that reviews the court’s finished work before it is accepted. Adopted from an outside designer’s parts list, built as runners/critic.js, then renamed FORSETI the same day. Still live.
provenance: Came from another designer’s design, not from this house. The 2026-11-01 gap analysis scored the Imperium about 6.5 of 8 against it and named the one hole: "Critic / reviewer | None | Missing".
evidence: Ledger: 2 calls under agent_id "critic" on 2026-11-01 (07:14:30 and 07:24:40, claude-haiku-5-5, $0.0006 total), then 4 calls the same day under "forseti". UPGRADE-2026-11-01.md Part 2 builds it, Part 3 renames it. campaign-log.md: "The Critic is renamed FORSETI (Norse god of justice)". warden.js still carries the migration renaming critic_* columns to forseti_*, and CRITIC_CONF still falls back to registry.critic.
why_it_survives: Four properties, none of them optional: it sees only the task as assigned and the files, never the ministry’s reasoning (fresh context); it runs a different and cheaper model than the generator (heterogeneity); it is capped at 2 revisions (a bounded stopping rule); and it advises without being able to edit. The Chimera-style generator-to-critic loop audited on 2026-11-10 was rejected because it had none of the four - same model, own reasoning in view, looping until self-satisfied.
correction: Logged 2026-11-11. On first reading of the ledger this was mis-described as an attempt tried briefly and dropped, because "critic" appears twice and never again. It was not dropped. It was renamed and is running tonight.
